label: USGS ShakeMap: ln IM at the bridges as a Gaussian field, from grid.xml and uncertainty.xml

imt.description: Which of the map's grids: PGA, PGV, PSA03, PSA10 or PSA30, with STD<field> from uncertainty.xml.

source.citation: USGS ShakeMap grid.xml and uncertainty.xml, PSA(1.0 s), read through src/builder/shakemap.py.

description: ln IM at the bridges as one Gaussian field, ln IM ~ N(mu, D R D) with D = diag(sigma): mu from grid.xml (e.g. PSA10 for SA(1.0)) and sigma from uncertainty.xml (STDPSA10), both interpolated bilinearly on the log scale at each bridge. R is the binding's correlation (a spatial-correlation set); without one the bridges are independent. A bridge off the map gets the map's value at its nearest edge, an upper bound (USGS maps reach to where shaking has faded to light), not zero; a map that reaches no bridge is refused; a map without uncertainty.xml gives sigma = 0 and says so. The map is already conditioned on its seismic stations: a station's reading entered again as SAObs counts twice.
